Usage: miniserv [options] [PATH]

Serves all files under PATH, defaulting to the current directory.
Options:
  --handle-404  Handle 404 errors by redirecting to /404.html
  --verbose     Log requests and their results to console
  -v|--version  Print version information and quit
  -h|--help     Print this help text and quit
